subject: A/B model swap induced tail latency in VelocityAI production
messages:
From: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@velocityai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: VelocityAI SRE <sre@velocityai.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T10:15:23Z
Subject: Sudden p95/p99 increase after A/B swap - production

Hi Irene / Laura,

We flipped the A/B model swap at ~10:07Z following your guidance and immediately started seeing a sharp increase in tail latency for our hosted API calls. p95 is up ~2.1x and p99 up ~3.5x compared to the hour prior. Error rate is still low but throughput has dropped by ~12% as requests queue.

Attached is a quick export from our Datadog window and a screenshot of the spike. Links: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/velocity/p95-p99-overview

Can you confirm whether the v2 variant has any known long-sequence performance regressions or if something in routing/batching changed with the new rollout? Our customers are seeing timeouts from SDKs which is starting to escalate.

We'd like this escalated — if rollback is the fastest mitigation we can approve it. Please advise immediate next steps.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Nolan
Head of Platform, VelocityAI

Attachments: velocity_p99_report_20280322.csv, screenshot_datadog_tail_spike.png

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@velocityai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T10:22:10Z
Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 increase after A/B swap - production

Hi Sarah — thank you for the quick alert and the traces. We're looking into it now.

Initial triage plan:
- Marcus (runtime) + Aditya (ops) are on the thread for immediate investigation.
- If rollback is the fastest mitigation, please confirm here and we'll execute via the hosted control plane (expected <10m).
- We'll stream logs and a short RCA within 4 hours; an incident postmortem will follow.

Laura — please let me know if Velocity wants us to roll back now; otherwise we will try to identify the root cause in the canary logs.

Irene Choi
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@velocityai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T10:32:05Z
Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 increase after A/B swap - production

Adding quick findings from the canary logs (initial):
- Canary variant v2-ab (model-id: redwood-v2-ab-2028-03) shows increased kernel time on longer sequences (seq_len > 1024).
- We saw increased KV cache miss ratio for that variant; cache warmup policy wasn't applied due to an ABI mismatch in the compiled kernels — that explains higher per-token CPU time.
- No obvious network saturation; requests are queuing on the execution nodes causing head-of-line latency.

Attached a short trace: canary_trace_v2.txt (excerpt below).
---
[2028-03-22T10:29:41Z] request_id=aa33: exec_time=742ms, build_kv_cache=false, seq_len=1536
[2028-03-22T10:29:42Z] request_id=aa34: exec_time=680ms, build_kv_cache=false, seq_len=1270
---

Immediate mitigation options:
1) Roll back traffic for VelocityAI to previous variant (redwood-v1-stable) — fastest.
2) Toggle fallback execution path that forces KV cache-enabled kernel (requires a quick config rollout, ~6-8m).

Given customer impact, I recommend rollback first. I'll standby for rollback command.

Marcus
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@velocityai.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T10:45:02Z
Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 increase after A/B swap - production

Sarah — I’m really sorry for the disruption. Thank you for flagging this so quickly.

Velocity: we can roll you back to the v1-stable variant immediately. If you approve, we’ll schedule the rollback now and confirm when p95/p99 are back to baseline. We will also offer 1 week of service credit for this outage window.

Please reply here with a one-line go-ahead and we’ll execute.

Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Operations Runbook <ops-runbook@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@velocityai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T10:51:40Z
Subject: ACTION: rollback traffic for VelocityAI hosted API to redwood-v1-stable

Runbook reference: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/rollback-hosted-model-v1

I authorize immediate rollback for VelocityAI (DEAL-4721-VEL) per customer approval. Steps below (ops):
1) Control plane: update routing rule for account velocityai -> model redwood-v1-stable (scope=hosted/api/accounts/velocityai)
2) Confirm new routing commit id and monitor p95/p99 for next 10 minutes
3) If error rates rise >0.5% or traffic drops >20%, cut traffic to manual safe-mode and escalate to oncall infra.

Rollback command snippet (control plane CLI):
redwoodctl rollout set-variant --account velocityai --route default --variant redwood-v1-stable --force

Aditya — please execute and post status. Marcus — keep tail traces streaming.

Irene Choi
Head of Customer Reliability

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@velocityai.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T11:02:12Z
Subject: Re: ACTION: rollback traffic for VelocityAI hosted API to redwood-v1-stable

Executed rollback at 2028-03-22T11:03:04Z (control plane commit: c7f9b2).
Immediate observational notes: p95 dropped back to baseline within ~90s; p99 trending down and stabilized by 11:05Z; throughput recovered to pre-swap levels. No increase in error rate observed post-rollback.

Short status:
- Rollback complete — velocity account now on redwood-v1-stable.
- Monitoring: Datadog dashboard shows p95/p99 back within thresholds (link: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/velocity/p95-p99-overview).
- Next steps: Marcus and I will collect runtime traces for a 4-hour window and hand to the incident postmortem team; schedule a follow-up call with Velocity tomorrow to review RCA and mitigation plan.

Aditya Rao
Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: canary_trace_v2.txt (uploaded).
